def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    base = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))

    # ---- order-level payments (only payments known by seed_time) ----
    pay = db['payments']
    pay_known = pay[pay['ts'] < seed_time]
    order_payments = pay_known.groupby('order_id').agg(
        total_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        avg_payment_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
        has_credit_card=('payment_type', lambda x: float((x == 'credit_card').any())),
        has_boleto=('payment_type', lambda x: float((x == 'boleto').any())),
    ).reset_index()

    # ---- order-level reviews (only reviews written by seed_time) ----
    rev = db['reviews']
    rev_known = rev[rev['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]
    order_reviews = rev_known.groupby('order_id').agg(
        avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
        num_reviews=('review_id', 'count'),
        share_positive=('review_score', lambda x: float((x >= 4).mean())),
    ).reset_index()

    # ---- historical order items for target products ----
    items = db['order_items']
    hist = items[items['product_id'].isin(set(entity_ids)) & (items['ts'] < seed_time)].copy()

    orders = db['orders'][[
        'order_id', 'order_status', 'order_purchase_timestamp',
        'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date'
    ]]
    # only orders whose purchase happened before seed_time
    orders_known = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]

    if hist.empty:
        features = base.copy()
        features['has_history'] = 0
        features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
        return features.astype(float)

    full = hist.merge(orders_known, on='order_id', how='left') \
               .merge(order_payments, on='order_id', how='left') \
               .merge(order_reviews, on='order_id', how='left')

    full['days_before_seed'] = (seed_time - full['ts']).dt.days
    full['window'] = pd.cut(full['days_before_seed'],
                            bins=[-1, 90, 180, 360, np.inf],
                            labels=['w1', 'w2', 'w3', 'older'])
    # delivery info is known only if delivery already happened before seed_time
    delivered_known = full['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & \
                      (full['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)
    full['is_delivered_known'] = delivered_known.astype(int)
    full['delivery_delay_days'] = np.where(
        delivered_known,
        (full['order_delivered_customer_date'] - full['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.days,
        np.nan
    )
    full['is_successful'] = (~full['order_status'].isin(['canceled', 'unavailable'])).astype(float)
    full['is_failed'] = full['order_status'].isin(['canceled', 'unavailable']).astype(float)

    def agg_window(df, suffix):
        if df.empty:
            return pd.DataFrame(index=base.index)
        g = df.groupby('product_id')
        out = pd.DataFrame({
            f'units_sold_{suffix}': g['order_item_id'].count(),
            f'num_orders_{suffix}': g['order_id'].nunique(),
            f'total_revenue_{suffix}': g['price'].sum(),
            f'total_freight_{suffix}': g['freight_value'].sum(),
            f'avg_price_{suffix}': g['price'].mean(),
            f'avg_freight_{suffix}': g['freight_value'].mean(),
            f'num_successful_orders_{suffix}':
                df[df['is_successful'] == 1].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique(),
            f'num_failed_orders_{suffix}':
                df[df['is_failed'] == 1].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique(),
            f'avg_delivery_delay_{suffix}':
                df.groupby('product_id')['delivery_delay_days'].mean(),
            f'avg_total_payment_{suffix}': g['total_payment'].mean(),
            f'avg_installments_{suffix}': g['avg_payment_installments'].mean(),
            f'pct_credit_card_{suffix}': g['has_credit_card'].mean(),
            f'pct_boleto_{suffix}': g['has_boleto'].mean(),
            f'avg_review_score_{suffix}': g['avg_review_score'].mean(),
            f'num_reviews_{suffix}': g['num_reviews'].sum(),
            f'share_positive_reviews_{suffix}': g['share_positive'].mean(),
        })
        out.index.name = 'product_id'
        return out

    features = base.copy()
    for w in ['w1', 'w2', 'w3', 'older']:
        sub = full[full['window'] == w]
        features = features.join(agg_window(sub, w), how='left')

    # ---- global history / recency ----
    g = full.groupby('product_id')
    prod_history = pd.DataFrame({
        'total_units_history': g['order_item_id'].count(),
        'total_revenue_history': g['price'].sum(),
        'avg_review_score_history': g['avg_review_score'].mean(),
        'total_reviews_history': g['num_reviews'].sum(),
        'last_purchase_ts': g['ts'].max(),
    })
    prod_history['days_since_last_purchase'] = \
        (seed_time - prod_history['last_purchase_ts']).dt.days
    prod_history = prod_history.drop(columns=['last_purchase_ts'])
    features = features.join(prod_history, how='left')

    features['has_history'] = features['total_units_history'].notna().astype(int)

    numeric_cols = features.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
    features[numeric_cols] = features[numeric_cols].fillna(0)
    features.loc[features['has_history'] == 0, 'days_since_last_purchase'] = 9999

    eps = 1e-6
    features['units_growth_w1_w2'] = \
        (features['units_sold_w1'] - features['units_sold_w2']) / (features['units_sold_w2'] + eps)
    features['revenue_growth_w1_w2'] = \
        (features['total_revenue_w1'] - features['total_revenue_w2']) / (features['total_revenue_w2'] + eps)
    features['units_growth_w2_w3'] = \
        (features['units_sold_w2'] - features['units_sold_w3']) / (features['units_sold_w3'] + eps)
    features['aov_w1'] = features['total_revenue_w1'] / (features['num_orders_w1'] + eps)
    features['aov_w2'] = features['total_revenue_w2'] / (features['num_orders_w2'] + eps)
    features['aov_w3'] = features['total_revenue_w3'] / (features['num_orders_w3'] + eps)
    features['freight_ratio_w1'] = features['total_freight_w1'] / (features['total_revenue_w1'] + eps)
    features['freight_ratio_w2'] = features['total_freight_w2'] / (features['total_revenue_w2'] + eps)
    features['success_rate_w1'] = features['num_successful_orders_w1'] / (features['num_orders_w1'] + eps)
    features['success_rate_w2'] = features['num_successful_orders_w2'] / (features['num_orders_w2'] + eps)

    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    return features
